meta.project: For you, Always. — Unbox the Memory

product_overview: For you, Always. is a digital atelier that lets customers browse interactive gift products and purchase a hybrid physical-plus-digital gift box experience. Buyers can customize a digital gift, enter delivery details, pay for a physical box, and then track order progress and courier delivery online.
core_goals: Browse gift products and explore their previews before purchasing
Customize a digital gift experience for a selected physical gift box
Complete checkout for a physical gift box with shipping selection and payment
Track order confirmation, digital gift access, and courier delivery status
Administer orders, fulfillment, and courier dispatch from an internal dashboard

features.name: Catalog Browsing & Filtering
features.description: Users can explore the gift catalog, filter products by occasion, and open product details to review features, pricing, and preview media.
user_flows: Navigate to /catalog -> Filter products by occasion -> Review the matching gift options -> Open a product detail page -> See product features, pricing, and preview media
Navigate to /catalog -> Browse the full catalog grid -> Open a product card -> See the selected product detail and next-step options

features.name: Unbox the Memory Product Discovery
features.description: Users can learn about the physical gift box offering and choose a suitable variant before starting checkout.
user_flows: Navigate to /catalog/unbox-the-memory -> Review the available box variants and stock availability -> Open the purchase path -> See the physical gift box details and checkout entry point

features.name: Unbox the Memory Physical Checkout
features.description: Users can purchase a curated physical gift box while selecting a digital gift experience, entering recipient details, choosing shipping, and completing payment.
user_flows: Navigate to /catalog/unbox-the-memory/checkout -> Select a digital experience -> Enter sender and recipient contact information -> Enter the shipping address details -> Choose a province and city to calculate shipping rates -> Review the order summary -> Proceed to payment

Navigate to /catalog/unbox-the-memory/checkout -> Select a digital experience -> Enter sender and recipient contact information -> Enter incomplete shipping details -> See form validation prevent continuation until required fields are completed

features.name: Order Status & Courier Tracking
features.description: Users can check their order progress, open the digital gift studio access, and follow courier delivery updates after purchase.
user_flows: Navigate to /order-status -> Enter or load the order reference -> View payment confirmation status -> Open digital gift studio access -> Review the order fulfillment timeline -> Track courier dispatch and delivery progress
Navigate to /order-status -> Enter or load the order reference -> View the current status of the physical box -> Review the latest courier tracking checkpoints -> See the delivery timeline update

features.name: Atelier HQ Admin Management
features.description: Authorized admins can sign in to a private dashboard, review orders and analytics, manage fulfillment, and trigger courier dispatch.
user_flows: Navigate to /atelier-hq -> Enter the admin password -> Access the dashboard -> Review sales analytics and revenue trends -> Search, filter, and paginate orders -> Update the resi tracking number -> Dispatch the courier for shipment
Navigate to /atelier-hq -> Enter an incorrect admin password -> See access denied and remain outside the dashboard
